Today, there is an update on the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
The India Meteorological Department, IMD, has issued a heavy rainfall alert for isolated areas across Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, and Karaikal for November 28, 2026. Thunderstorms, lightning, and gusty winds are also anticipated in these regions. Districts such as Nilgiris, Coimbatore, Tenkasi, Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli, and Kanniyakumari are specifically forecast to receive heavy rainfall. Meanwhile, Chennai and its suburban areas are expected to experience light rainfall. Looking ahead, a new low-pressure area is predicted to form over the Bay of Bengal on November 30. This system is expected to gradually intensify into a depression over the southeastern Bay of Bengal by December 2.
